headers.X-Crumbtrail-Auth: <ingest key; omit the header entirely when unset, never send empty>

delivery.$comment: A non-2xx response is a refusal, not a delivery. Four outcomes must be distinguished.
delivery.non2xx: do not retry the identical batch; record a capture gap
delivery.capture202Shed: 202 with body {capture:"shed", reason, retryAfterSeconds} accepted the request and discarded the evidence: record a capture gap carrying the server's reason, and send nothing further until Retry-After has passed
delivery.sessionStart: a refused /api/session/start leaves no session, so every later /api/events for that id is refused too. Stop capture, say so once on the platform's log, and do not post a session's worth of events into a 404
